items.name: Finnish FMC Championship 2025
items.information:
**This is an FMC only competition. No speedsolving events will be held.**
Please read through the [regulations](https://www.worldcubeassociation.org/regulations/) before the competition.
We highly recommend not bringing any guests. However, we're required to allow 1 guest per competitor.

**Tämän kisan ainoa laji on vähiten siirtoja. Speedsolving -lajeja ei pidetä.**
Lue säännöt ([englanniksi](https://www.worldcubeassociation.org/regulations/), [suomeksi](https://www.worldcubeassociation.org/regulations/translations/finnish/)) ennen kilpailua.
Suosittelemme saapumaan ilman vieraita. Joudumme kuitenkin sallimaan yhden vieraan per kilpailija.

items.name: Big N Sides at Bangalore 2025

venue.name: Jus'Trufs Chocolate Shop & Cafe
venue.address: Jus'Trufs - Chocolate Shop & Cafe, 9, Jakkur Rd, Jakkuru Layout, Jakkur, Bengaluru, Karnataka 560064

items.information:
* All participants must be present for the entire duration of the competition irrespective of the number of events.
​
* All the participants are requested to volunteer in the competition and every participant (except newcomers) will be assigned to a particular event they have to either judge, scramble, etc for the group/event.
 
* Only one guest per participant is allowed owing to space constraints in the venue.

items.name: Honolulu Mega a Makapō 2025
items.information:
![](https://www.worldcubeassociation.org/rails/active_storage/blobs/redirect/eyJfcmFpbHMiOnsiZGF0YSI6NDgyNDQsInB1ciI6ImJsb2JfaWQifX0=--d739808be3a2373fd1129978150c3798d3405ee0/IMG_1309.png)
### The competition weekend in Oʻahu continues with an amazing side events competition!

* It is recommended you register as soon as possible to save a spot.
* Be sure to familiarize yourself with the WCA regulations. If this is your first official competition, [this video](https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=8dSuMG--wm8) will provide you with most of the information you need.

### This competition will be specializing in niche events and will not have 3x3 or any traditional events. If you would like to sign up for a competition involving those events, please check out [Honolulu Hāʻulelau 2025](https://www.worldcubeassociation.org/competitions/HonoluluHaulelau2025), happening on October 4th, the day before.

items.name: GA Cubers Three Bananas 2025
items.information:
This competition will **not** hold the 3x3x3 speedsolving event. Instead, it will hold some other official events as well as the unofficial events of **Banana Cube**, **FTO**, and **Three-Person TeamBLD**.  See the **Unofficial Events** tab for more information.

This competition is supported by [Southeast Cubing, Inc.](https://southeastcubing.org/about)! **Please check out the Southeast Cubing tab to learn more about the official nonprofit organization for speedcubing in the Southeast and what you can do to support the mission.**
